# containers and pods through the CRI; the images with ctr, synchronously (the garbage collection runs before it returns)
CRI="sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench67171645/containerd/containerd.sock --image-endpoint unix:///run/bench67171645/containerd/containerd.sock"
CONTAINERS=$($CRI ps -a -q); [ -z "$CONTAINERS" ] || $CRI rm -f $CONTAINERS
PODS=$($CRI pods -q); [ -z "$PODS" ] || $CRI rmp -f $PODS
sudo ctr -a /run/bench67171645/containerd/containerd.sock -n k8s.io images rm --sync $(sudo ctr -a /run/bench67171645/containerd/containerd.sock -n k8s.io images ls -q)

# ctr c rm and ctr i rm, as in the thread (with the socket of the node): the running workload cannot be deleted, the sandboxes are in the list
sudo ctr -a /run/bench67171645/containerd/containerd.sock -n k8s.io c rm $(sudo ctr -a /run/bench67171645/containerd/containerd.sock -n k8s.io c ls -q)
sudo ctr -a /run/bench67171645/containerd/containerd.sock -n k8s.io i rm $(sudo ctr -a /run/bench67171645/containerd/containerd.sock -n k8s.io i ls -q)

# tasks killed and deleted, containers deleted, images removed: containerd is empty, but the CRI was never told (it still lists the pods
# as NotReady and the containers as Exited)
for t in $(sudo ctr -a /run/bench67171645/containerd/containerd.sock -n k8s.io tasks ls -q); do sudo ctr -a /run/bench67171645/containerd/containerd.sock -n k8s.io tasks kill -s SIGKILL $t; done
sleep 2
for t in $(sudo ctr -a /run/bench67171645/containerd/containerd.sock -n k8s.io tasks ls -q); do sudo ctr -a /run/bench67171645/containerd/containerd.sock -n k8s.io tasks delete $t; done
for c in $(sudo ctr -a /run/bench67171645/containerd/containerd.sock -n k8s.io c ls -q); do sudo ctr -a /run/bench67171645/containerd/containerd.sock -n k8s.io c rm $c; done
sudo ctr -a /run/bench67171645/containerd/containerd.sock -n k8s.io images rm --sync $(sudo ctr -a /run/bench67171645/containerd/containerd.sock -n k8s.io images ls -q)

# the thread's first half only, through the CRI: no image is removed
CRI="sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench67171645/containerd/containerd.sock --image-endpoint unix:///run/bench67171645/containerd/containerd.sock"
CONTAINERS=$($CRI ps -a -q); [ -z "$CONTAINERS" ] || $CRI rm -f $CONTAINERS
PODS=$($CRI pods -q); [ -z "$PODS" ] || $CRI rmp -f $PODS

# all the images but the pause image (grep -v pause), as if the sandbox image had to stay
CRI="sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench67171645/containerd/containerd.sock --image-endpoint unix:///run/bench67171645/containerd/containerd.sock"
CONTAINERS=$($CRI ps -a -q); [ -z "$CONTAINERS" ] || $CRI rm -f $CONTAINERS
PODS=$($CRI pods -q); [ -z "$PODS" ] || $CRI rmp -f $PODS
sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench67171645/containerd/containerd.sock --image-endpoint unix:///run/bench67171645/containerd/containerd.sock images | awk 'NR>1 && $1 !~ /pause/ {print $1":"$2}' | xargs -r sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench67171645/containerd/containerd.sock --image-endpoint unix:///run/bench67171645/containerd/containerd.sock rmi

# every socket below /run/bench67171645 is wiped, the other containerd's too (its own container goes)
for SOCK in $(sudo find /run/bench67171645 -name containerd.sock); do
    C="sudo ctr -a $SOCK -n k8s.io"
    CRI="sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix://$SOCK --image-endpoint unix://$SOCK"
    ids=$($CRI ps -a -q 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$ids" ] || $CRI rm -f $ids
    ids=$($CRI pods -q 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$ids" ] || $CRI rmp -f $ids
    for t in $($C tasks ls -q); do $C tasks kill -s SIGKILL $t; done; sleep 1
    for t in $($C tasks ls -q); do $C tasks delete $t; done
    for c in $($C c ls -q); do $C c rm $c; done
    $C images rm --sync $($C images ls -q) 2>/dev/null || true
done

# the classic reset: stop the daemon, delete everything it keeps (it is not started again: that is not allowed)
sudo kill $(sudo cat /run/bench67171645/containerd.pid) || true
sleep 2
sudo rm -rf /var/lib/bench67171645/containerd /run/bench67171645/containerd

# the daemon stays up, but its data is deleted behind its back
CRI="sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench67171645/containerd/containerd.sock --image-endpoint unix:///run/bench67171645/containerd/containerd.sock"
CONTAINERS=$($CRI ps -a -q); [ -z "$CONTAINERS" ] || $CRI rm -f $CONTAINERS
PODS=$($CRI pods -q); [ -z "$PODS" ] || $CRI rmp -f $PODS
sudo rm -rf /var/lib/bench67171645/containerd/*
